primary_selection: Largest exact model score among the three baseline methods; ties use ascending method name. Select the best combined-seed candidate by score only.
ablation_budget: 12 proposals per mode, with 16 internal gap-relocation trials per gap proposal. Proposal counts are equal; CPU budgets are not.
evaluation: Freeze this configuration and candidate generation code before opening accuracy results. Evaluate all seeds, ablations and families; no reference accuracy filtering. Three development families, five evaluation families. This is a small exploratory pilot, not a pristine held-out benchmark or preregistered study.
